financial_anchor.metric: Q2 2026 revenue and free cash flow
financial_anchor.caveat: Reported/adjusted measures differ; cycle, mix and capital intensity confound.

ai_claim.claim: Lumi and digital drilling are plausible SLB AI/digital mechanisms, but neither the product page nor a named customer deployment was successfully opened in this audit.
ai_claim.limitation: No opened deployment cohort, field KPI or retained-economics evidence.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: oil cycles, offshore mix and ChampionX integration dominate results.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: No exact source-backed annual operating-income denominator was verified, so the prior $250m hurdle is withdrawn. Q2 revenue, free cash flow and net income are different measures and cannot substitute for annual operating income without a stated conversion.

arithmetic.inputs: pool $6bn eligible engineering, field-service and digital operations cost/revenue pool; efficiency 12%; realization 40%; retained share 50%; recurring cost $100m
arithmetic.formula: eligible cost × efficiency × realization × retained share − recurring AI expense
